digest.component_or_area: test suite logging instrumentation and guards
propositions: Negative caplog assertions (assert not [...]) pass vacuously when zero records are captured, providing no coverage while appearing green
Logger propagation is disabled process-globally by configure_logging() and install_stderr_handler() without restoration, causing downstream caplog assertions to silently see empty record lists
Logger level raised to WARNING on the shared rebar logger prevents INFO-level records from being captured by caplog regardless of caplog.at_level() configuration
Five negative caplog assertions in the test suite were susceptible to void execution depending on test run order and which tests invoked CLI entry points in-process
A guard fixture must detect and fail loudly when logger propagation is disabled or level is raised during test execution, catching the poisoning at its source rather than at random victim tests
